Mistral gave its flagship the nickname Le Chonk and shipped it in two steps. A public preview arrived in October 2026, and open weights followed on October 29. The preview version has since been retired and the October 29 release is the active model, so anyone still pointing at preview weights should move. The model is natively multimodal, with roughly 1 trillion total parameters and about 49 billion active, and Mistral positions it for agentic coding and cybersecurity work. [...] Five open-weight model families dominate the November 2026 conversation: Kimi K3.1 Pro, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Mistral Large 4, GLM-5.3 and Gemma 4. They share a label and almost nothing else. Mistral publishes a named license (the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License, which Mistral describes as a modified MIT license), while a third-party comparison of open-weight licenses flags that several rivals need a closer read of the model card before you ship anything on top of them. [...] Mistral and NVIDIA on engineering workflows (October 21, 2026). Mistral announced a collaboration with NVIDIA on AI-native engineering, using Mistral Large 4 alongside simulation and physics pipelines and NVIDIA accelerated computing. Neil Ashton, identified as Mistral’s VP of Computational Engineering, appears in the announcement. Lesson: open weights let an industrial buyer keep sensitive design data inside its own simulation stack.

# Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): Open Weights, License, Price and Benchmarks

By Lenka Vojtechova  ·  Updated November 7, 2026  ·  12 min read

AI NewsMistralOpen-Source ModelLLMAI Coding

Mistral Large 4, nicknamed Le Chonk, is a 1-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 49 billion active parameters. Mistral AI released it as a public preview API on October 6, 2026, then shipped an improved final version and the open weights on October 29. It reads text and images, answers in text, and now costs $0.70 per million input tokens. [...] Yes. Mistral released the weights on Hugging Face on October 29, 2026, two days after the date it gave reporters. They cover the improved final model, and come with an NVFP4 checkpoint for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs. The licence is the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight license, a modified MIT licence.

 

How much does Mistral Large 4 cost?

$0.70 per million input tokens and $2.10 per million output tokens, with cached input at $0.07, since October 29, 2026. The preview listed at $1.36 and $4.18.

On 20 October 2026, Crédit Agricole Artificial Intelligence announced a partnership that involves Mistral in building the group's AI platform, beyond access to its models: an agent for retail banking clients, agentic processes, and cybersecurity, presented as "a major focus". The announcements from BNP Paribas and HSBC, already partners of Mistral, do not mention cybersecurity. The announcement sets no amount, duration, model, or exclusivity.

STStephane Nachez · ·4 min [...] The 20 October release cites three workstreams: a conversational agent for clients of the group's retail banks, the "agentic transformation of key processes", and cybersecurity. Crédit Agricole Artificial Intelligence runs the group's AI foundations. With Mistral's technology, it also plans to adapt large language models to its data and use cases. The release sees this as a way to optimise performance, "and therefore the consumption of computing resources and its environmental impact". [...] The 20 October release gives no amount, no commitment duration, no timeline for the client agent, and cites no particular Mistral model. It also says nothing about any exclusivity. The pattern recalls that observed with Mistral at EDF, BMW, or Airbus: partnerships announced, rarely quantified. The announcement comes six weeks after the lab's 3 billion euro fundraising.

message.content:
## Recent developments
* **Launch of Mistral Large 4 ("Le Chonk"):** Mistral released its flagship 1-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model (49 billion active parameters) with native multimodality, targeting agentic coding and cybersecurity work. Following an October preview, open weights and an NVFP4 checkpoint for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs were published on October 29 under the modified-MIT *Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License*. API pricing dropped to $0.70/M input tokens.
* **Acquisition Rumors:** Reports surfaced that Mistral has agreed to an all-stock acquisition by Initech Holdings valued at $41 billion, with the transaction expected to close in Q1 2027.
* **Major Enterprise & Engineering Partnerships:** 
  * Partnered with NVIDIA (announced October 21) on AI-native engineering, pairing Mistral Large 4 with simulation and physics pipelines.
  * Secured a platform partnership with Crédit Agricole (October 20) focusing on retail banking conversational agents, agentic process transformation, and cybersecurity.
  * Orange Cyberdefense became a design partner for cybersecurity, integrating Mistral Large 4 into penetration testing and incident response services.

## Talking points
* **Model Performance & Efficiency:** Inquire about adoption rates and feedback for "Le Chonk" (Mistral Large 4), particularly regarding its cost-efficiency ($0.70/M input tokens) and utility in enterprise agentic workflows.
* **Sovereign AI & Cybersecurity Focus:** Discuss how the partnerships with Orange Cyberdefense and Crédit Agricole position Mistral as the go-to European sovereign provider for high-security, sensitive industry verticals.
* **Hardware Optimization:** Discuss the integration of the NVFP4 checkpoints for NVIDIA Blackwell architecture and how it impacts inference costs and performance at scale.
* **M&A Rumor Context:** Gently probe how potential structural shifts (such as the reported $41B acquisition talks by Initech Holdings) might impact Mistral’s roadmap, autonomy, and open-weight commitment.

## Open questions
* How will the reported acquisition by Initech Holdings affect Mistral's independent corporate identity and its open-weight release philosophy?
* What concrete timeline or deployment milestones have been established for the Crédit Agricole and Orange Cyberdefense integrations?
* Are there near-term plans to scale Mistral Large 4 optimizations to non-NVIDIA hardware stacks following the Blackwell-focused checkpoint drop?

## Sources
* [Open Source AI Models: 3 Run Paths, 48% Index [2026]](https://shattered.io/open-source-ai-models-3-run-paths-mistral-large-4-kimi-k3-1-glm-5-3-2026)
* [Mistral Large 4: Open Weights, License, Price, Benchmarks](https://felloai.com/mistral-large-4)
* [Crédit Agricole partners with Mistral AI on platform](https://www.actuia.com/en/news/frances-credit-agricole-taps-mistral-ai-to-build-its-ai-platform)
* [Orange Cyberdefense becomes Mistral AI design partner for cybersecurity – MSP Business](https://mspbusiness.com/en/market-and-strategy/orange-cyberdefense-becomes-mistral-ai-design-partner-for-cybersecurity)
